content_sections.heading: IFFCO AGT Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The online application process for IFFCO Agriculture Graduate Trainee Recruitment 2026 closes on 14 October 2026 . Candidates must submit their applications through the official recruitment link before the deadline. Applications submitted through any other mode will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: IFFCO AGT Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants for IFFCO AGT Recruitment 2026 must hold a full-time, four-year B.Sc Agriculture degree from a recognized university or institute. The minimum required aggregate percentage differs for General/OBC and SC/ST candidates. Candidates must possess a four-year B.Sc (Agriculture) full-time regular degree from a university or institute recognized by UGC/AICTE. CGPA Candidates: Applicants who have a CGPA score must convert it into a percentage while filling out the online application form. Yes. Candidates with a four-year, full-time regular B.Sc Agriculture degree from a UGC/AICTE-recognized university or institute can apply if they meet the required minimum marks, age limit and language conditions.

content_sections.heading: IFFCO AGT Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age for IFFCO Agriculture Graduate Trainee Recruitment 2026 is 30 years as on 1 September 2026 . Relaxation in the upper age limit is available to eligible SC, ST and OBC Non-Creamy Layer candidates. Age Reckoning Date: 01 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: IFFCO AGT Salary and Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: IFFCO Agriculture Graduate Trainees will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 33,300 during the one-year training period. After successful completion of training, trainees may be absorbed into the regular pay scale depending on organizational requirements. Important: Absorption into a regular position is not automatic. It depends on successful completion of training and IFFCO's requirements.

content_sections.heading: IFFCO AGT Training Period and Posting 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will undergo a training period of one year . The Agriculture Graduate Trainee positions are intended for IFFCO field offices located across India. After training and possible absorption, candidates may be posted at any of IFFCO's states, projects or establishments across India, according to organizational needs.

content_sections.heading: IFFCO AGT Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process for IFFCO Agriculture Graduate Trainee Recruitment 2026 includes preliminary and final online tests, followed by a personal interview and medical examination. Preliminary Online Test: Eligible candidates must appear for a computer-based test in an open environment using their own computer or laptop with an internet connection. Final Online Test: Candidates shortlisted through the preliminary test will be called for a final online examination at designated centres in a controlled environment. Personal Interview: Candidates progressing through the selection process may be called for an interview. Medical Examination: Candidates shortlisted after the personal interview must meet IFFCO's prescribed medical standards before final selection. IFFCO management reserves the right to change the selection process depending on the number of applications received.

content_sections.heading: IFFCO AGT Language Requirements 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must have reading, writing and speaking proficiency in the regional language of the state for which they apply. Knowledge of the relevant regional language is mandatory. Knowledge of more than one language will be an added advantage. Knowledge of Hindi is desirable.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for IFFCO AGT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit their applications online through the IFFCO Agriculture Graduate Trainee recruitment link by 14 October 2026. Applications through any other mode will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post available under IFFCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IFFCO has invited online applications for the post of Agriculture Graduate Trainee (AGT).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IFFCO Agriculture Graduate Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 14 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for IFFCO AGT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a four-year full-time regular B.Sc. (Agriculture) degree from a UGC/AICTE-recognized University or Institute.

faq.question: Q4. What minimum marks are required for IFFCO AGT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: General/OBC candidates need at least 60% aggregate marks, while SC/ST candidates need at least 55% aggregate marks in B.Sc. (Agriculture).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IFFCO Agriculture Graduate Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years as on 01 September 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for eligible SC/ST and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend during IFFCO AGT training?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a stipend of Rs. 33,300 per month during the one-year training period.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary after completing IFFCO AGT training?
faq.answer: On successful completion of training and subject to IFFCO's requirement, AGTs may be absorbed at a basic pay of Rs. 37,000 per month in the pay scale of Rs. 37,000–70,000.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IFFCO AGT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Preliminary Online Test, Final Online Test, Personal Interview and Medical Examination.
